categories.evidence: Lacks the Utils label; while it edits `src/util/hasher.h`, the change specifically tunes `SaltedOutpointHasher` to affect `CCoinsMap` node layouts in validation rather than general utility infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Unranked because this change does not belong to the utils category.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies hashing behavior specifically to optimize the in-memory UTXO cache (`CCoinsMap`) during IBD and AssumeUTXO loading.
categories.rationale: Provides a modest 2% to 3% speedup to IBD/reindex and ~11% during AssumeUTXO loading, traded against higher memory usage per cache node. Benchmarks demonstrate reduced SipHash recomputation in `CCoinsMap`, but the optimization relies on implementation-defined `libstdc++` behavior and is reasonably deferrable.
